name: Ocal Browser v10.1.23 Stable
body:
## 🌌 Ocal Browser v10.1.23 — Release Notes & Update Catalog

### 📁 Reworked Bento File Manager (`ocal://file-manager`)
* **Overhauled File Explorer Architecture**: Sleek glassmorphic bento cards, instant media previewing, and dynamic directory navigation.
* **Fast Batch Operations & Tree Hierarchy**: Direct folder tree navigation, search filtering, batch file management, and storage telemetry.

### 🤖 AI Sidebar Bug Fixes & Stabilization
* **Smooth Streaming & Interaction**: Fixed message streaming latency and response rendering glitches across long multi-turn sessions.
* **Context & Persistence Fixes**: Streamlined auto-focus transitions, formatted code syntax copy buttons, and solid tab state persistence.

### 📄 High-Resolution PDF Reader & Visual Polish (`ocal://pdf-viewer`)
* **Restored Icons & Toolbar Buttons**: Restored missing sidebar and thumbnail control icons.
* **Crisp Ultra-HD Rendering**: Overhauled canvas rasterization up to 500% zoom with razor-sharp vector text and crystal-clear thumbnail generation.

### ⚡ Core Engine Performance & Turbo Acceleration
* **V8 Garbage Collection & Memory Savings**: Greatly reduced inactive tab memory footprint and eliminated idle process overhead.
* **GPU Driver Hardware Acceleration**: Accelerated D3D11 graphics and shader pipeline for smooth, jitter-free 60+ FPS navigation.

### 🛡️ Intelligent Permission Prompt & Origin Memory
* **Clean Shadowless Dialog**: Modern, shadowless permission request popups for camera, microphone, geolocation, and notifications.
* **Persistent Origin Security Memory**: Seamlessly preserves site permission choices per origin across restarts.

### 🎨 Deep Theme & Search Engine Synchronization
* **Color-Scheme Header Harmonization**: Dynamically synchronizes user light/dark preferences with search engines and websites natively.

### 👥 New Team Contributors
* **Vikram Sengupta** — *Document Systems Engineer* (High-Resolution PDF Rendering & Canvas Rasterization)
* **Zara Al-Mansoor** — *Privacy & Security Systems Dev* (Origin Permission Security & Shadowless Prompts)

### 📦 Artifacts
* `Ocal-10.1.23-Setup.exe` (SHA-256 Signed Win32 Inno Setup Executable)
* `Ocal Browser 10.1.23.msix` & `Ocal Browser 10.1.23.appx` (Signed Microsoft Store Packages)
* `Ocal-MSIX-Setup.exe` (Dedicated MSIX installer with embedded certificate)
* `GamingNetworkStudioMediaGroup.cer` (Official Public Publisher Certificate for Windows & MS)
